SELECT l.id AS log_id, l.user_id AS user_id, u.real_name AS real_name, a.platform AS platform, a.account_name AS account_name, l.sync_type AS sync_type, l.sync_result AS sync_result, l.commit_count AS commit_count, l.cost_ms AS cost_ms, l.error_msg AS error_msg, DATE_FORMAT(l.create_time, '%Y-%m-%d %H:%i:%s') AS create_time FROM repo_sync_log l LEFT JOIN repo_account a ON a.id = l.account_id AND a.deleted = 0 LEFT JOIN sys_user u ON u.id = l.user_id AND u.deleted = 0 WHERE l.deleted = 0 AND l.user_id = #{q.userId} AND l.sync_type = #{q.syncType} AND l.sync_result = #{q.syncResult} AND l.create_time >= #{q.beginTime} AND l.create_time <= #{q.endTime}
ORDER BY ${orderByClause} ORDER BY l.create_time DESC, l.id DESC
